name: HAMAL
description: HAMAL is a private, self-hosted LAN file and temporary clipboard transfer service. Create temporary rooms, connect devices with QR codes, transfer files directly across your local network, or use the room-scoped Text / Clipboard channel for commands, terminal output, logs, configuration, URLs, and plain text. Optional PIN protection and automatic room expiration keep transfers temporary and private.

paths.name: Appdata Storage
paths.description: Persistent storage directory for SQLite database, uploaded files, and server secrets. The container runs as Unraid's standard UID:GID 99:100.
